$comment: Managed by aio. Install harness overwrites it.
title: End record of a run, version 1
description: What `.aio/aio done` writes to .aio/done.json in the run's checkout when an agent finishes, and what Modules.Runs reads as untrusted input. The outcome is a free string that the state's `on` maps; `blocked` is reserved and fails the run with its reason.

version.description: The schema version. A reader refuses any other.

outcome.description: The result the state's `on` maps, such as approved, rejected, ready or gaps. `blocked` means the agent could not go on.

reason.description: Why, in the agent's words. Required when the outcome is blocked.

problems.description: Problems the agent found and did not fix, one per entry.

at.description: When the record was written, in UTC. A record older than its run belongs to an earlier run.
